title: MANSION KEEL FOREVER (Big Room × Orchestral Trance × 90s Rave) [138]
style: big room festival anthem meets orchestral trance and 90s piano rave, 138 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave English + Spanish + te reo Maori, massive layered supersaw stack, full cinematic string section, classic 90s rave piano stabs, gated reverb snares, hoover bass in drop, four-on-the-floor festival kick, soaring lead synth, choir pad swells, snare rolls 4-8-16-32, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, milestone-anthem festival-mainstage-finale ecstatic mood, sidechain pumping pads to kick, mainstage 2026 closing-set production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(string swell, choir pad, distant 90s piano stab)
(MAN... SION... KEEL... FOR... E... VER...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(¡clari... dad! āe... mārama!)

[Build]
(piano stabs lock in, snare roll 4-8-16-32, hoover sweeps in)
MAN — SION! KEEL! FOR — E — VER!
KEEL — CLEAR! KEEL — CLEAR!
¡CLA — RI — DAD! MĀ — RA — MA!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(snare roll peaks, riser tops out)

[Drop 1]
(festival kick four-on-the-floor, supersaw stack, strings stabbing)
MAN — SION!
KEEL — FOR — EVER!
336!
G4 — LENS!
(chop stack +7) yes-yes-si-si-āe-āe
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(strings carry, piano runs, chops trade left-right)
(McIVOR!) (SONGPAL!) (ZYNCONTEXT!)
(VDS!) (HUB!) (KEEL!)
(G4 LENS!) (336!) (CODA!)
(ZYNROSE!) (ZYNKEEL!) (ZYNRIP!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE LINE —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to piano + strings + choir, no kick)
(whispered) mansion... keel... forever...
(soft) claridad... claridad...
(soft) mārama... mārama...
(piano lifts to full lead motif)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(snare roll builds 8-16-32, choir peaks, riser tops)

[Drop 2]
(double-time festival drop, full orchestral stack peak, all anchors)
MAN — SION — KEEL — FOR — EVER! (yes yes yes!)
336! G4 — LENS! VDS! HUB! (¡sí sí sí!)
SONGPAL! ZYNCONTEXT! McIVOR! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(festival kick fades, strings resolve, piano motif holds)
(mansion... keel... forever...)
(claridad... mārama...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(piano motif holds long, choir fade, silence)
